desc: Identify the convolution characterization: for present \(B\), self-convolution coefficient at \(2B\) counts ordered endpoint pairs whose sum is \(2B\).
Derive triplet conversion: subtract the diagonal \((B,B)\), divide remaining ordered endpoint pairs by two, and sum only over present middles.
Implement an efficient exact iterative NTT convolution suitable for presence arrays indexed through \(10^6\).
Build the presence array from stdin, aggregate \((\operatorname{conv}[2B]-1)//2\), and print the integer result.
Validate transform sizing, modular coefficient non-wrapping, boundary indices, and small/no-progression cases.
